text: Illustration. A different car, April 20th account
In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
observed: 15.0 to 15.8 s: the white car with empty seats turns diagonally, grows larger as if lifted, moves out into the middle of the brown band with a foam bulge and wake lines on its upstream side, and drifts left until it is partly out of frame at 15.8 s. Caption remains below, clear of the car.
